name: Palak Paneer
instructions_en: Wash and blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, then grind to a smooth puree. Heat 2 tbsp oil, fry cumin, then chopped onion till golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato, salt, turmeric. Cook till oil separates. Add spinach puree, simmer 5 minutes. Add paneer cubes and garam masala, cook 3 more minutes. Do not overcook the paneer.

name: Dal Tadka
instructions_en: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and salt (3 whistles). For tadka, heat ghee, add cumin, dried red chilli, chopped garlic (skip garlic if Jain), and chopped tomato. Cook 2 minutes, pour over dal. Simmer 3 minutes, finish with coriander leaves.

name: Vegetable Pulao
instructions_en: Soak rice 20 minutes. Heat ghee, add whole spices (bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves). Fry sliced onion till golden, add mixed vegetables and salt, saute 3 minutes. Add rice and water (1:2), cook covered on low till done. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Tomato Rasam
instructions_en: Cook and mash a little toor dal. Boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, rasam powder, salt. Add mashed dal and simmer 5 minutes. Temper mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, and asafoetida in ghee, pour over. Garnish with coriander. Serve with rice.

name: Egg Bhurji
instructions_en: Heat oil, fry chopped onion and green chilli till soft. Add chopped tomato, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, cook 2 minutes. Break in the eggs and scramble on medium heat till just cooked. Finish with coriander. Serve with roti or pav.
